text: イワヤマトンネルに　いったけど　まっくらで　こわいよ　ポケモンに　フラッシュで　あかるく　させればなあ…

structure.jp: イワヤマトンネルに　いったけど
structure.en: I went to Rock Tunnel, but

structure.jp: まっくらで　こわいよ
ポケモンに　フラッシュで　あかるく　させればなあ…
structure.en: if only I could have a Pokémon make it bright with Flash…

patterns.name: 〜ばなあ
patterns.explanation: The ば form means 'if', and なあ after it turns it into a wish: 'if only'. させればなあ = 'if only I could have it do that'.

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.span: ポケモンに　フラッシュで　あかるく　させれば
patterns.explanation: させる means making or letting someone else do something, and に shows who is made to do it. ポケモンに あかるく させれば = 'if I had a Pokémon make it bright'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど joins two parts of a sentence with 'but'. いったけど = 'I went, but'.
